root_cause.text: The macsmc-hwmon driver contained two critical bugs: the voltage sensor registration loop used the wrong prefix ("volt-" instead of "voltage-") and incorrectly assigned sensors to the temperature sensor array instead of the voltage sensor array, leading to out-of-bounds memory access; additionally, the integer-to-float conversion function `macsmc_hwmon_write_f32()` had flawed exponent logic for values >= 2^24 and lacked mantissa masking, causing incorrect SMC writes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the sensor loop changing both the prefix string from `"volt-"` to `"voltage-"` and the target array from `hwmon->temp.sensors` to `hwmon->volt.sensors`; the float conversion is corrected by reworking exponent handling and adding `& FLT_MANT_MASK` to mask the mantissa field.
